prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1458; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-referenced individual in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

We request that you provide a complete statement of the liability coverage limits available under the policy applicable to the insured driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage of which you are aware, along with a copy of the declarations page.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or event data recorder information, dash camera footage, repair and appraisal records for the vehicles involved, and any witness contact information in your possession. Routine destruction or alteration of these materials should be suspended until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
